ValidationRule.description: ETA must follow shipping, delivered shipments need a delivery stamp no earlier than shipping, and ETA cannot be more than 60 days away.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Shipped_At__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Estimated_Arrival__c)), OR(Estimated_Arrival__c <= Shipped_At__c, Estimated_Arrival__c > Shipped_At__c + 60)), AND(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Delivered'), OR(ISBLANK(Delivered_At__c), Delivered_At__c < NULLVALUE(Shipped_At__c, Delivered_At__c))), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Delivered_At__c)), DATEVALUE(Delivered_At__c) > TODAY() + 1) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Shipment ETA or delivery timestamps are inconsistent.
